name: Page flip
summary: Paper page with a curling edge turns across the frame like a book page, with a shadow along the fold.

params.name: mode
params.note: in turns a page over the frame, out turns it away

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames the page takes to turn

author: krakujs
